personal.title: Full Stack Developer
personal.tagline: Building modern web applications, mobile experiences, and digital solutions for businesses and startups.
personal.bio1: Hi, I'm Ömer — a Full Stack Developer passionate about building modern digital products that combine performance, functionality, and great user experience. I enjoy turning ideas into real-world solutions that help businesses grow and operate more efficiently.
personal.bio2: My expertise covers the entire development process, from frontend interfaces and user experience to backend systems, databases, APIs, and deployment. I build corporate websites, SaaS platforms, admin dashboards, custom business systems, and mobile applications using technologies such as React, Next.js, Node.js, React Native, Supabase, and PostgreSQL.
personal.bio3: Beyond software development, I also help businesses strengthen their digital presence through landing pages, logo design, catalogs, and branding-focused digital experiences. Whether it's a web platform, a mobile application, or a complete business website, my goal is always to deliver solutions that are professional, scalable, and easy to maintain.

projects.label: My Work
projects.heading: Projects I'm
projects.desc: Software I've built and designs I've crafted — all for real clients.

saas-analytics-dashboard.title: SaaS Analytics Dashboard
saas-analytics-dashboard.description: A comprehensive analytics platform with real-time data visualization, multi-tenant team management, and automated reporting built for a B2B SaaS company.
saas-analytics-dashboard.longDescription: This project involved building a full-stack analytics dashboard from scratch for a B2B SaaS client. The platform handles real-time data ingestion, custom chart rendering, and role-based access control across multiple tenant organizations. Key challenges included optimizing database queries for large datasets and building a responsive, data-dense UI that remained intuitive.

ecommerce-mobile-app.title: E-Commerce Mobile App
ecommerce-mobile-app.description: A cross-platform React Native shopping app with product discovery, real-time inventory, Apple Pay / Google Pay, and push notifications for a retail client.
ecommerce-mobile-app.longDescription: Built a feature-complete e-commerce mobile application for iOS and Android. The app includes a product catalog with advanced filtering, cart management, integrated payment via Stripe, and order tracking. Implemented push notification campaigns that increased returning customer sessions by 35%.

restaurant-management-system.title: Restaurant Management System
restaurant-management-system.description: Full-stack POS and kitchen management system with real-time order tracking, table management, inventory control, and daily reporting for restaurant chains.
restaurant-management-system.longDescription: Developed an end-to-end restaurant management system replacing a legacy paper-based process. The system includes a table-side ordering tablet interface, real-time kitchen display system (KDS), inventory tracking with automatic reorder alerts, and comprehensive sales reporting.

ai-content-platform.title: AI Content Platform
ai-content-platform.description: A content generation platform powered by AI with team collaboration, content scheduling, SEO analysis, and multi-channel publishing to WordPress, Medium, and social media.
ai-content-platform.longDescription: Built a multi-tenant AI writing assistant platform. Features include AI-powered content generation, collaborative editing with real-time cursors (like Notion), SEO scoring, and one-click publishing to multiple channels. The platform scaled to 500+ active teams within three months of launch.

real-estate-portal.title: Real Estate Portal
real-estate-portal.description: Property listing platform with interactive maps, advanced search filters, virtual tour integration, mortgage calculator, and agent CRM for a real estate agency.
real-estate-portal.longDescription: Designed and built a full property portal to replace a third-party listing service. Integrated Mapbox for interactive property maps, built a custom search engine with geo-filtering, and connected to a virtual tour provider for immersive property previews.

fitness-tracking-app.title: Fitness Tracking App
fitness-tracking-app.description: A React Native fitness app with custom workout plans, progress tracking, macro logging, wearable integration, and a social feed for workout sharing.
fitness-tracking-app.longDescription: Built a comprehensive fitness tracking mobile application. Users can create custom workout programs, log meals with nutritional data, track body metrics over time, and connect Apple Health / Google Fit. Social features allow sharing workout achievements.
